_comment: V3 measurement sanity gates. See README.md in this directory before using or editing.

desktop.derivedFrom: --v3-max 1320px; at any viewport >= 1320 + 2*32 padding the wrap clamps to its max
desktop._note: 1440x900x1 gave innerWidth 1800 on this host (dpr 0.8). Verify, do not assume.

mobile.derivedFrom: below 900px the wrap takes full width; padding is inside the border box, so the element width equals the viewport

_environmentWarning: The emulate arguments below are ENVIRONMENT-SPECIFIC, not universal. On this host devicePixelRatio is 0.8, so 1440x900x1 yields innerWidth 1800 and 1152x720x1 is needed for a true 1440. The LIVE site needed 1440x900x1. Both are correct in their own context. The gate's value is the VERIFICATION STEP, not the argument — always read window.innerWidth and compare before trusting any rect.
